chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī, with his chain of transmission,
that Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said:
"Whoever pays Zakāt al-Fiṭrah, Allah will complete with it whatever is lacking in the zakat of his wealth."

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.تَمَّمَ: completed or made up in full
key_terms.زَكَاةَ الْفِطْرَةِ: the alms of fiṭrah due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.زَكَاةِ مَالِهِ: the zakat due on one’s property or wealth

ai.seo_question: How does paying Zakāt al-Fiṭrah relate to deficiencies in the zakat of one’s wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith states that paying Zakāt al-Fiṭrah has a compensatory spiritual effect regarding deficiencies in one’s wealth zakat. It highlights the importance of this act of worship and its connection to financial purification.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2084 - In a narration from Al-Sakuni, with his chain of transmission, it is reported that Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Whoever pays Zakat al-Fitr, Allah (swt) will complete with it whatever is lacking in the Zakat of his wealth."
